title: Initial configuration for a phase
statement: Let $z$ be a Boolean input list, let $s$ specify a phase together with a list of previously computed vertex values, a list of marked cells, and a work-head position $j$, and let $i$ be a natural number with $i\le |z|$. The associated two-work-tape machine configuration has input $z$, first-read state carrying the phase of $s$, input-head position determined by $i$, value tape initialized from the recorded vertex values, mark tape initialized from the recorded marked cells, work-head position $j$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: State data $s$ containing a phase, computed values, marked cells, and position
caveat: The definitions of the configuration-building functions and tape encodings are absent, so the precise input-head and tape-construction conventions are not supplied.
